offer.name: Local Search Autopilot
offer.niche: Independent gyms, PT studios and sports-therapy clinics
offer.promise: Four search-optimised articles, twelve social captions and four Google Business posts a month — written, scheduled and published for you. You approve; you never write.
deliverables: 4 x 900-word blog posts targeting local search terms
1 x monthly email to their list
Posted straight to their site as drafts — one tap to publish
offer.why_this_niche: You train, you eat like an athlete, you already speak the language. A gym owner can tell in two sentences whether the person emailing them has ever set foot in a squat rack. That credibility is the whole sale, and it is the one thing a competitor cannot copy from you.

plan.task: Build the lead list — 60 gyms/PT studios with a website and a visible email
Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + LEADS_CSV to GitHub secrets, run the outreach workflow once by hand
Send the first 20 approved emails (4/day, weekday mornings)
Send the next 20. Reply to every response within the hour
First call booked — offer the first month at £125 to remove the risk
Client 1 live. Run the delivery workflow, check the pack, send it
Send the last 20 emails. Ask client 1 for one referral
Clients 2 and 3 live. Raise price to £250 for new sign-ups
Client 4 live — £1,000/month. Stop outreach, or keep going to £2k
Past £1,000 of trading income in a tax year: register as a sole trader with HMRC

admin_notes: UK trading allowance is £1,000 per tax year. Below that, nothing to declare. You will pass it in month one, so register as a sole trader with HMRC when you do — it takes ten minutes and the deadline is 5 October after the tax year ends.

Cold email to a limited company is legal under PECR with a clear opt-out in every message. Sole traders and partnerships count as individuals and need consent — so only email businesses that are registered companies, and drop anyone who asks, permanently.
Keep the client's approval in writing before anything is published live. The engine writes drafts by default for exactly this reason.
